description: Ekipa sprzątająca bo zmieciemy konkurencje albo zostaniemy i będziemy sprzątać.
summary:
We developed a Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions.
It's main purpose is to notify crew members about their health state. It's necessary, so the people don't struggle with any deficiencies or health problems. It not only send notifications, but also takes measurements and tells you what you should do to maintain appropriate results.
details: Our invention is injected into the human body with a purpose of analyzing it from the inside. It's based on Nanomachines. They roam around the organism scanning and gathering necessary information for the user. Our project aims at a new way to monitor astronauts' health in space. We used Super Inteligence for image generation. Our project is atmost creative because we are the first ones to design it. The factors that we took into considerations are of course creativity, innovation and team work.
